info_subtitle: Understanding landslides and staying safe in the North Eastern Region
info_what_body: A landslide is the movement of rock, soil, and debris down a slope. In India's North Eastern Region, heavy monsoon rain, steep hills, and saturated soil make landslides a recurring threat to villages, roads, and lives.
info_why_title: Why is our region at risk?
info_why_body: The NER's young, fragile mountains and intense rainfall create ideal conditions for slope failure:
info_why_1: Steep Himalayan and Patkai hills with loose soil
info_why_2: Heavy monsoon rainfall (often 200–400 mm in 24 hours)
info_why_3: Deforestation and road cutting on unstable slopes
info_why_4: Earthquakes that weaken rock and soil structure
info_sign_1: New cracks in the ground, walls, or roads
info_sign_2: Doors or windows that suddenly stick or won't close
info_sign_3: Trees, poles, or fences tilting downhill
info_sign_4: Muddy water or debris flowing on slopes
info_sign_5: Unusual rumbling or cracking sounds from hillsides
info_sign_6: Rapid rise or muddy colour in streams and springs
info_tier_advisory_desc: Conditions are being monitored. Stay informed and review your family safety plan.
info_tier_watch_desc: Risk is elevated. Avoid unnecessary travel on hill roads and stay alert for warning signs.
info_tier_warning_desc: High risk of landslide. Move away from slopes immediately and follow evacuation instructions.
info_before_1: Know your nearest safe shelter and evacuation route
info_before_2: Keep an emergency kit: torch, water, medicines, documents
info_before_3: Clear drains and avoid dumping waste on slopes
info_before_4: Subscribe to SMS alerts on this portal for your zone
info_during_title: During heavy rain or a Warning alert
info_during_1: Move to higher, stable ground away from steep slopes
info_during_2: Do not cross flooded streams or damaged roads
info_during_3: Stay indoors if safe; avoid travelling on hill roads
info_during_4: Call 1078 (NDMA) or local authorities if you see slope movement
info_after_1: Do not return until authorities declare the area safe
info_after_2: Watch for further slides — one event often triggers others
info_after_3: Report blocked roads and casualties to local disaster management
info_help_line: For emergencies call NDMA Helpline 1078. Use the Safety & Evacuation page for local relief centre details.
